name: Khan Academy (Khanmigo)

ai_features.name: Khanmigo (tutor + teacher assistant, GPT-4 based)
ai_features.what: Socratic chat tutor that withholds direct answers; teacher tools for lesson plans, rubrics, quizzes

scale.value: ~2 million by end 2024-25 school year (795 US districts, 770,000 US students)
scale.source: secondary summaries of Khan Academy statements (aiforcause.org, ai-brainer.com); not re-checked on Khan Academy primary page

evidence.study: Oreopoulos & Low (Univ. of Toronto), 18 Tennessee middle schools, low-achieving students, 2024-2026
evidence.design: 2-year RCT, Khan Academy + Khanmigo vs standard remediation (IXL, Zearn, DeltaMath)
evidence.finding: Khan Academy improved math vs standard remediation but gains were modest and matched earlier Khan studies without AI; Khanmigo added no extra learning benefit; low take-up (about 15% active use) because it refuses direct answers
evidence.doi_or_url: https://hechingerreport.org/proof-points-khanmigo-math-ai-tutor/ (NBER draft, Aug 2026; NBER URL not located)

evidence.study: Khan Academy 'Methodologies for Improving the Quality of AI Tutoring in K-12' (arXiv 2608.11259)
evidence.design: industry deployment metrics and live experiments, no RCT
evidence.finding: quality/engagement metrics; e.g. richer learner-record signals improve next-item correctness 6.1% (secondary report)

business.value: districts about $15 per student per year; families $44 per year; free for Title I via philanthropy

privacy_note: US K-12 deployment via district contracts; details not reviewed
note: A claim in one secondary source of an 'RCT with Harvard and Stanford' showing significant gains was NOT corroborated; do not cite. The strongest independent evidence is the Toronto RCT, found via press (Hechinger), draft paper not read.

name: Duolingo (Super / Max)

ai_features.name: Duolingo Max: Explain My Answer, Roleplay (GPT-4)
ai_features.what: LLM explanations of right/wrong answers and open conversation practice

ai_features.name: Video Call (Lily)
ai_features.what: spoken conversation with an AI character; per Q2 2026 letter most new Super subscribers now get access

evidence.study: Jiang et al. 2021/22, Foreign Language Annals, n=225 US adults, Spanish and French beginner courses
evidence.design: cross-sectional proficiency testing (ACTFL) against 4-semester university students; commissioned/funded by Duolingo
evidence.finding: learners reached Intermediate Low reading and Novice High listening, comparable to 4 university semesters (median 99-125 hours); pre-dates the LLM features

evidence.study: Cambridge SSLA study comparing Duolingo, classroom, and classroom+Duolingo for beginner French

note: Figures from the SEC 8-K. A secondary source (Class Central) reports a shift of focus from monetisation to user growth with a 100M DAU target by end 2028; the 8-K text fetched did not state it. No independent evidence on Max's AI features specifically was found. The Cambridge study's author and findings are unread (study entry is a pointer).

name: Carnegie Learning (MATHia, Cognitive Tutor)

ai_features.name: MATHia
ai_features.what: cognitive-model intelligent tutoring system, step-level hints and mastery tracking; classic ITS, not an LLM

scale.value: company claims millions of students; no primary figure retrieved

evidence.study: RAND / Pane et al., Cognitive Tutor Algebra I effectiveness trial, 147 schools, 7 states, 19,000+ students (2007-2010)
evidence.finding: no significant effect in year 1; effect about 0.20 SD in year 2 at high school (about 8 percentile points)

evidence.study: WWC review of Cognitive Tutor, Maui School District (569 students)
evidence.design: RCT meeting WWC standards without reservations
evidence.finding: indeterminate effects, no significant positive finding
Carnegie Learning Math Solution (blended) ESSA Strong (Level 1); MATHia used alone Moderate (Level 2), per vendor press release, not re-checked on evidenceforessa.org

note: The best-evidenced product in the set, and a mixed record: one large RCT with a delayed 0.20 SD effect, one WWC-rated RCT with null results. A good counter-example to 'AI tutors work' and a reference for effect-size expectations.

name: Squirrel AI Learning

ai_features.name: Adaptive learning system with knowledge-point graph
ai_features.what: fine-grained knowledge graph, per-student path adaptation, human teacher in loop in learning centres

scale.value: claimed millions; no primary figure verified

evidence.study: Wang, Christensen, Cui, et al. 2023, Interactive Learning Environments 31(2):793-803 (two studies: n=200 and n=102 eighth graders)
evidence.design: randomised assignment, Squirrel AI vs expert-teacher large-group and small-group lessons; authors affiliated with Squirrel AI
evidence.finding: g=0.54 and 0.73 in favour of Squirrel AI on a math test; only 3 days, different topics and formats, novelty effect

note: Co-authored by company staff; short duration. Treat as vendor-affiliated evidence.

name: Chegg

ai_features.name: Chegg Study with AI; pivot to 'employability platform'
ai_features.what: homework help displaced by general chatbots; now Chegg Study, Chegg Skills, Busuu

note: The clearest case of generative AI destroying an incumbent's revenue; reported by press from filings, 10-Q not read directly. Also cited by the vault's higher-ed note.

name: MagicSchool

ai_features.name: 80+ teacher tools plus student rooms
ai_features.what: lesson plans, IEP drafting, rubrics, parent comms, student tutor with guardrails

business.value: $45M Series B led by Valor Equity (Jan 2025) after $15M Series A (2024); about $65M total

note: No independent learning-outcome evidence found; teacher time saving is self-reported.

ai_features.name: Browser extension for teacher AI tools; Boost student tool
ai_features.what: feedback, differentiation and lesson generation inside Google Docs/Classroom

name: Alpha School (2 Hour Learning)

ai_features.name: 2 Hour Learning
ai_features.what: AI-driven adaptive apps for core academics in about 2 hours; guides replace teachers; afternoons on projects

evidence.study: Vendor MAP analyses ('2.6x faster growth', top 1-2% nationally)
evidence.finding: cannot attribute to the model; selection bias

evidence.study: Unbound Academy (Arizona public charter using the model), first year 2025-26
evidence.finding: 10% math proficiency (target 60%) and 28% English (target 65%), below Arizona averages (as reported by a blog, unverified against state data)

note: Marketing claims dominate; Pennsylvania Department of Education reportedly called the model untested (secondary). No peer-reviewed study found.
